---
title: "Summary of District-wise Dengue Cases by Year"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 20
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(denguedatahub)

data(srilanka_weekly_data)

annual_df <- srilanka_weekly_data %>%
  group_by(year, district) %>%
  summarise(
    annual_cases = sum(cases, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(annual_df, aes(y = factor(year), x = annual_cases)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#d73027") +
  facet_wrap(~ district, ncol = 6, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Dengue Cases",
    title = "Year-wise Dengue Cases by District"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )
```
